skill.name: canvas-design
skill.description: Create static visual artwork by turning a user concept into a design philosophy, then expressing it as polished PNG or PDF canvas work.
skill.summary: Turn abstract concepts into design-forward static artwork with philosophy, typography, and canvas composition guidance.
skill.author: ArtemisAI

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are false positives from OFL license text, Markdown inline code, design guidance, and bundled font assets. Semantic review found a fabricated user instruction and an unbounded external font download instruction that should be remediated before publication.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the line claiming the user already requested perfection. State refinement goals as author guidance without impersonating the user.
Remove the instruction to download any needed fonts. Limit use to bundled fonts or an allowlist with hashes and licenses.
Publish source, license, and hash provenance for each TTF file. Re-run binary asset review before release.

content.value_statement: Users need a repeatable way to turn abstract concepts into polished visual artifacts. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through philosophy, composition, typography, and PNG or PDF output.
actual_capabilities: Creates a concise visual philosophy before producing the final artifact.
Guides single-page PNG or PDF canvas composition.
References bundled font assets for varied typography choices.
Emphasizes sparse text, spatial hierarchy, color, form, and rhythm.
Supports multi-page variations when the user requests a series.
Requires refinement passes for margins, overlap checks, and visual polish.
limitations: Does not include executable rendering code or a design application.
Final output quality depends on the host agent and available rendering tools.
Bundled fonts need provenance review before automated marketplace distribution.
It is optimized for static artwork, not interactive layouts or animation.

use_cases.title: Create a Gallery Poster
use_cases.description: Turn an event concept into a polished poster with visual hierarchy, sparse text, and expressive typography.

use_cases.title: Develop Abstract Brand Art
use_cases.description: Translate a brand mood or theme into a static artwork suitable for campaigns, decks, or editorial visuals.

use_cases.title: Produce a Visual Series
use_cases.description: Create related pages that share one design philosophy while varying layout, rhythm, and visual emphasis.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Poster
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one static design.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a one-page poster for a late-night jazz event using a refined visual philosophy and minimal text.

prompt_templates.title: Brand Mood Artwork
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a static PNG for a ceramics studio that feels quiet, precise, tactile, and contemporary.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Page Series
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three related PDF pages for an exhibition catalog using one philosophy and distinct compositions.

prompt_templates.title: Refined Final Pass
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for critique and refinement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the canvas for spacing, hierarchy, typography, and overlap. Refine it without adding unnecessary elements.

output_examples.input: A poster for an experimental film night.
output_examples.output: A concise design philosophy plus a PNG poster with cinematic abstraction, restrained labels, and strong spatial rhythm.

output_examples.input: A launch image for a premium notebook brand.
output_examples.output: A PDF artwork with tactile composition, sparse product text, careful margins, and typography chosen from bundled fonts.

output_examples.input: A three-page art series about memory and urban maps.
output_examples.output: Three connected pages that share one visual language while varying scale, pattern, and focal structure.

best_practices: Give the skill a clear subject, mood, audience, and output format.
Ask for sparse text and name the few words that must appear.
Review margins, overlap, and font choices before accepting the final artifact.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to copy a living artist or existing commercial design.
Do not use it for dense documents that need extensive body text.
Do not permit arbitrary external assets without source and license review.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates static visual artwork, usually as a PNG or PDF, guided by a written design philosophy.

faq.question: Can it make multi-page outputs?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports multi-page visual series when the user requests related pages.

faq.question: Does it include rendering software?
faq.answer: No. It provides instructions and font assets. The host agent must have tools to create files.

faq.question: Can it use custom fonts?
faq.answer: It includes bundled fonts. External fonts should only be used from reviewed and licensed sources.

faq.question: Is it suitable for text-heavy documents?
